st-mp-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-mp-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Madhya Pradesh

st-mp-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

holder.name: Nagendra Singh
holder.notes: Corrected 2026-09-25: See the Gurh correction in this same file: both Member of the Legislative Assembly and Member of the Legislative Assembly had holder.wikipedia pointing at the disambiguation-adjacent page for the late ICJ judge Nagendra Singh instead of the correct politician page. This is the Nagod MLA's own page (assumed office 2018, previously MLA 2003-2013, also ex-MP for Khajuraho 2014-2019). (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagendra_Singh_(politician,_born_1943))

holder.name: Nagendra Singh
holder.notes: Corrected 2026-09-25: Coverage-report investigation of MP's MLA count found two different positions (Gurh and Nagod) both pointing holder.wikipedia at the same URL, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagendra_Singh — which is actually the biography of the late ICJ judge/CEC Nagendra Singh (1914-1988), not either MLA. Wikipedia's Nagendra_Singh_(disambiguation) page lists them as two distinct living MP politicians: 'Nagendra Singh (Gurh politician)' (b. 1942, 5-time MLA from Gurh, Rewa district) and 'Nagendra Singh (politician, born 1943)' (MLA from Nagod). This is not the duplicate-MLA integrity issue itself (both are legitimate, differently-seated positions, correctly counted once each), just a mislinked source URL, fixed here to the correct per-person page. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagendra_Singh_(Gurh_politician))
